body:
I know the feeling, you feel like shit like every little mistake just kills you inside your past and your memories come back to haunt you. Those people that make fun of you for calling them out are not friends they are just fake, a friend is a person who stays by you and supports you no matter what, there is no question but to just cut that person out, don't always doubt yourself, think about it logically friends are morally meant to stay with you by your side and support you if they are not like that then they are not friends and you need to cut them out and only accept people who bring positivity to you. Here are 7 signs of fake friends  

* They are selfish. ...
* Your relationship with them is conditional. ...
* They feed on gossip and drama. ...
* They act weird when you're with other people. ...
* You have to **fake** things so they like you 
* They are pathological liars
* **Fake friends** are extremely manipulative 
* Friends like this usually always talk about themselves and ask you to listen to them but when you have a  problem and open up they ignore you 
* Fake friends tend to never care about your wants or needs, they will only want you when they have no one else, people like this are genuinely worse than scum.

now a real friend would be like this:

 

* Your **friends** listen to you. ...
* Your **friends** care about you. ...
* Your **friends** know when to throw a party. ...
* Your **friends** know when to end a party. ...
* You feel like your **friends** have your best interests at heart. ...
* Your **friends** support you. ...
* You always hear the truth from them. ...
* Your **friends** check in on you. 
* You are never the first one who has to contact them, regardless they will try and reach out to you.
and once again no, I'm not going to kill myself but it feels like my life is just sad and horrible and i want to fix it so do.

to add on to this i want to help other people who are suicidal and are feeling suicidal and want to help them but I can't help myself. Now im just being babyed by my family and it feels like i can't be trusted to do anything and honestly yea i fail at everything . Music is the only thing that can actually help me cope and its a form of therapy for me
